UPDATE shelf_entries
         SET edition_id = $2, status = $3, position = $4, shelf_position = $5, rating = $6,
             rating_visibility = $7, take = $8, dnf_reason = $9, progress = $10, updated_at = $11,
             started_at = $12, finished_at = $13, current_page = $14
         WHERE id = $1
